> Stack-specific standards for personal projects. Syncs to Directive standards + repo `CLAUDE.md`. Notation: **!** = MUST, **~** = SHOULD, **⊗** = MUST NOT.
## Swift / SwiftUI (ViLM)
- ! Respect size-class-driven navigation; validate layout on a physical iPhone before merging.
- ! Preserve existing defaults when adding seams for testability (default-preserving refactors).
- ~ Keep views thin; push logic into testable models/view-models.
- ⊗ Don't introduce behavior changes inside a refactor commit.
## Testing
- ! Characterization tests before refactoring legacy code.
- ~ Cover new runtime logic with unit tests; UI-only tweaks may rely on device validation.
## Tooling
- ! Xcode project committed cleanly; no stray build artifacts.
- ~ Node ≥ 20 + pnpm for any JS-based tooling in personal repos.
